2026 年 1 月 1 日起计算资产；一人上限 $130,000。: Assets count again from January 1, 2026; the limit is $130,000 for one person.
Medicare 是联邦医保，通常从 65 岁开始；Medi-Cal 是加州的: Medicare is federal health insurance, usually from age 65; Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid, free or low-cost coverage for people whose income and assets meet its rules. They are separate cards with separate applications, and people who qualify can have both.
第一步：预约免费咨询，不急着选保险产品: Step 1: book free counseling before choosing a plan
加州 HICAP 提供免费、保密的一对一 Medicare 咨询，家属可以一起来: California's HICAP gives free, confidential one-on-one Medicare counseling, and family members can join. Call 1-800-434-0222 or find your county office on the official page; ask for Chinese or an interpreter when you book.
县级办公室与全州电话 1-800-434-0222。: County offices and the statewide line, 1-800-434-0222.
第二步：把报名时间放在选计划之前: Step 2: confirm enrollment dates before selecting coverage
Medicare.gov 写明：首次报名期从 65 岁生日所在月的前 3 个月开: Medicare.gov says your first sign-up window starts 3 months before the month you turn 65 and ends 3 months after it: 7 months in all. If you miss it without other qualifying coverage, the Part B premium typically goes up 10% for each year you could have signed up, for as long as you have Part B. If you still work, use a spouse's employer plan, COBRA or already have Medi-Cal, work out your dates with HICAP first.
2026 年的费用（Medicare.gov）：Part B 保费每月 $202: 2026 costs (Medicare.gov): the Part B premium is $202.90 a month, more at higher incomes; the Part B deductible is $283 a year; the Part A hospital deductible is $1,736 per benefit period.
记下生日月份、现在的保险名称、在职和保险结束日期。: Note the birth month, the current insurance, and when work and that coverage end.
带上保险卡、收到的报名或续保信，以及想继续看的医生名单。: Bring insurance cards, any enrollment or renewal letters, and the doctors you want to keep.
列出药名、剂量和常用药房；比较计划时一起问保费、医生网络和药品覆盖。: List medicines, doses and your usual pharmacy; when comparing plans, ask about premiums, doctor networks and drug coverage together.
问清 Medicare、Medi-Cal 和 Medicare Savings: Ask for the deadlines of Medicare, Medi-Cal and the Medicare Savings Programs separately.
第三步：保费和药费压力，分别问清帮助项目: Step 3: ask about premium and prescription assistance separately
DHCS 列出四种申请 Medi-Cal 的方式：网上（BenefitsCal: DHCS lists four ways to apply for Medi-Cal: online (BenefitsCal or Covered California), by phone with your county office, by mail with a paper application, or in person at a county office.
2026 年 1 月 1 日起，Medi-Cal 对 65 岁以上、残障或住护理: Since January 1, 2026, Medi-Cal counts assets again for people who are 65 or older, have a disability or live in a nursing home. Through June 30, 2027 the limit is $130,000 for one person plus $65,000 for each extra person in the household; your main home, main vehicle and household items do not count. From July 1, 2027 it drops to $21,000 for one person and $31,000 for two.
Medicare Savings Programs 由州判断资格，可帮付 Med: The state decides who qualifies for the Medicare Savings Programs, which can pay Medicare premiums and sometimes deductibles and copayments. Medicare.gov advises applying even if you don't think you qualify. Go over drug-cost Extra Help with your HICAP counselor.

I'd like to ask about sign-up deadlines, doctor and drug coverage, and help with premiums. Can you arrange Chinese or an interpreter? What should I bring?
